annotations.title: Ask a Fantasize cruise specialist to help plan a trip

description: Sends one email to the person's own address. Their click in that email confirms the request; only then does it reach a Fantasize cruise specialist, who replies to them by email to help plan and book the trip. Free; no account is created and nothing is charged. Takes the trip they want in a sentence or two, and optionally dates, travellers, budget, home city and the sailing ids they looked at.

email.description: The person's own email address, given with their consent

sailing_ids.description: Fantasize sailing ids they looked at (up to 6)

what.description: The trip they want help with, e.g. "Alaska in July 2027 from Seattle, balcony, two adults, first cruise"

name: request_trip_help
